where: verify/derive.js or-target-cancel and the evidence.js “(excluding …)” skip (c144a08)
why: derive.js is right: it cancels K only for two alternatives, one S + K and the other S excluding exactly K, and it reads the first alternative from ors[0] alone. Tested by script in a scratch copy, as derive.js stratNeeds and through evidence.js targetNeeds. These stay unparsed: the round-1 bites (LD MONSTER | LD SLAANESH excl. MONSTERS; SLAANESH MONSTER | KHORNE excl. MONSTERS); three alternatives (three variants, including two that once gave any:[Khorne, Slaanesh]); K in S (“… SLAANESH MONSTER units (excluding MONSTERS)”, which once gave Slaanesh); “excluding K and L”, “K or L”, “K/L”, “K, L”; a run of two keywords (PINK HORRORS, EPIC HERO); an exclusion on both alternatives. Exclusion first, “one other”, “that cannot FLY” and CHARACTERS all give S, which is right. Before vs after across all 263 stratagems: no needs changed, and one label changed, Archagonists kw-or-same → or-target-cancel. Nit: it adds an empty rule label '' because c.rules is [] when sets.length is 1. The hole is in evidence.js. The commit says “any other exclusion among alternatives stays unparsed”, but that holds only when derive.js sees the exclusion. needsOf reads an “(excluding …)” only right after the unit or within 60 characters of it. A further one, as in “One LEGIONES DAEMONICA MONSTER unit or up to two LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH units from your army that are wholly within 6\" of each other and of your Warlord (excluding MONSTERS)”, gives alternatives with no none. combineAlts gives all:[LD], any:[Monster, Slaanesh]. The skip no longer applies (no or-target-cancel), so evidence.js lays none:[Monster] over the whole union. That is {all:[LD], any:[Monster, Slaanesh], none:[Monster]}, which drops the first alternative completely, and it is not unparsed. Added as a fixed case in a scratch evidence.js, it fails. Before c144a08 the skip gave the union. No stratagem today has this shape, so nothing on screen is wrong. Fix: in evidence.js targetNeeds, a TARGET whose derive reasons include or-target (but not or-target-cancel) and whose first sentence has “(excluding” is unparsed. Add it as a fixed case.

where: BOXES s|1pislf8 Shield of Honour: no box
why: GW (both caches identical): “When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have: - -1 to hit rolls. - -1 to wound rolls.” This is a penalty on the enemy’s attacks, so no attack box is right. With no BOXES key, dmBoxRules lists it under “Not counted in the Damage tab” with GW’s words (dmStratText) for every unit it can target, so it is not hidden.

where: BOXES s|jmtnfy Enfilading Emergence: kind all
why: GW: WHEN “End of your Movement phase.”, EFFECT “Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.” That is ranged and melee, and kind:'all' with lasts:'turn' (this turn’s Fight phase) is right. DURATION_RE drops only “until the end/start of (the|your|…) <phase> phase”, so a phase named any other way still sets the kind.

where: BOXES r|16kt1jq Assemblage of Might: gains q “that target a dreadful foe unit”
